messages:
jess: quick sanity check — I'm deploying the log-shipper chart into the `logging` ns and adding IRSA. the role ARN i'm annotating on the SA is arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-logshipper-prod-role. anyone see an obvious issue?
rafael: make sure the annotation key is `eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn` (not iam.amazonaws.com). also confirm the OIDC provider exists for the cluster.
sam: +1 to eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn. helm values need to enable the SA and add the annotation, e.g.:
```
serviceAccount:
  create: true
  name: logshipper
  annotations:
    eks.amazonaws.com/role-arn: arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/redwood-logshipper-prod-role
```
maya: our terraform module creates the aws_iam_role but double-check the trust policy — it must reference the cluster OIDC and the subject should be `system:serviceaccount:logging:logshipper`. example trust snippet I use: 
```
condition = {
  test = "StringEquals"
  values = { "${oidc_provider}:sub" = "system:serviceaccount:logging:logshipper" }
}
```
jess: thanks — we are using the module but I copied the role name from staging and updated the ARN. rlly want to avoid downtime — how quick to roll this out?
rafael: safe path: create role + attach policies first, then update helm values and `helm upgrade --install`. rollout is just pods restarting; use `kubectl rollout status` to watch.
infra-bot: deploy-bot: terraform apply for iam-role-success in 2m (plan approved by jess).
sam: if you hit `Forbidden` with sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity, check the trust policy audience (aud) is `sts.amazonaws.com` and `StringLike` for sub is correct. also check `kubectl describe sa logshipper -n logging` to confirm annotation landed.
maya: another gotcha — if using projected SA token (default in newer k8s) the pod needs `automountServiceAccountToken: true` or the helm chart must not disable it.
jess: good call. the chart had `automountServiceAccountToken: false` by default. I'll flip it and run upgrade.
sam: one more debug tip: run `kubectl -n logging exec -it $(kubectl -n logging get pods -l app=logshipper -o name | head -n1) -- curl -sS http://169.254.169.254/latest/meta-data/` — if you see no IMDS it's expected; IRSA uses web identity (check pod env for AWS_ROLE_ARN).
rafael: also ensure the IAM policy has only the permissions it needs (logs:PutLogEvents, s3:GetObject) and attach via aws_iam_role_policy_attachment or inline policy.
jess: ok i'm applying role changes now and will post results. thanks all :thumbsup:
infra-bot: deploy-bot: helm upgrade logging/logshipper --namespace logging completed in 18s.
jess: rollout done, pods are up. logs show successful STS assume role. closing this thread — will follow up if anything flaps.
